description: This PHP class 'Base64Attachment' represents a file attachment encoded in Base64, including properties like filename, file type, size, and content. It provides methods for constructing objects, accessing and modifying properties, and creating instances from uploaded files or arrays.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A data transfer object for handling Base64-encoded file attachments, with methods for encoding, decoding, and initialization from different sources.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of Base64Attachment with filename, file type, base64 content, and size.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the decoded content from base64, or null if decoding fails.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Encodes the given content in base64 and stores it.

methods.name: createFromUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an instance from Symfony's UploadedFile object by encoding its content.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance from an array with keys 'name', 'type', 'base64', and 'size'.
